admission.justification: Guarded by jargon unit tests; prevents unexplained mathematical jargon walls in Abitur-level prose, broken concept/term directives across all levels, line-number drift after frontmatter, and false failures from scanning AR onboarding/ cards.

applicability: Directive resolution and Level-1 prose jargon ordering across <memory>/docs/concepts/*.md and <memory>/docs/stages/<stage_id>/*.md in src/rh_pipeline/validate/jargon.py.
conditions: {{concept:slug|...}} (split on the first pipe with math/brace awareness) and {{term:slug[|display]}} directives outside code and math must resolve to registered Concept Cards in all sections.

Inside Level-1 prose (## Level 1 headings on stage pages or pre-Level-2/3 body on Concept Cards), registered terms, aliases, -s/-es plurals and premature {{term:...}} directives before the page's first {{concept:slug|...}} reveal emit jargon-before-reveal with exact real file lines (+ line_offset), while exempting code, math, link URLs, hyphenated compounds, own_slug and Level-2/3 sections.
validate_explainer_docs scans only docs/concepts/*.md and one-level docs/stages/<stage_id>/*.md and never scans AR onboarding/ cards.
exclusions: Word-boundary matching uses (?<![\w-])...(?![\w-]), so underscore-joined identifiers are not matched as standalone terms; root docs/*.md, stages/*.md and nested stage subdirectories are outside explainer scan scope.
statement: check_page_jargon and validate_explainer_docs scan strictly <memory>/docs/{concepts,stages}/ (never onboarding/), resolve {{concept:slug|...}} on the first pipe and {{term:slug}} across all sections, and enforce Level-1 jargon-before-reveal for raw terms, aliases, simple English plurals (-s/-es), and premature term directives while exempting code, math, link URLs, non-hyphenated boundaries, own_slug, and Level-2/3 prose.
title: Explainer directive resolution and Level-1 jargon-before-reveal gate
